sql: SELECT "Examination"."ID" AS k, ("Examination"."aCL IgA" - "Examination"."aCL IgM") AS m1 FROM "Examination" WHERE ("Examination"."aCL IgA" - "Examination"."aCL IgM") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
